name: records
title: Validation records: one laboratory result per row with expected CTCAE grades
description: Feed the as-received columns (VAL, UNIT, LLN, ULN, DATE, REF_DATE, BASELINE_FLAG or BASE_*) to the implementation under test, merge its output back on RECORD_ID and compare with the EXP_* columns of the version being validated. Missing expected grade = not gradable, never 0. Terms compare case- and whitespace-insensitively.

fields.name: RECORD_ID
fields.description: Stable integer key; adopters carry it through their pipeline and merge their output back on it

fields.name: SUBJECT_ID
fields.description: Synthetic subject, e.g. ALT-H-Y (<LBTESTCD>-<H|L>-<arm>); one subject per test x direction x baseline arm

fields.name: SCENARIO_ID
fields.description: Record scenario, e.g. ALT-H-Y-06 (<SUBJECT_ID>-BL for the baseline record)

fields.name: MODULE
fields.description: CORE = boundary records every implementation must pass; BASELINE = baseline selection and abnormal-baseline arms; MISSING = missing result or limit; NOTDONE = NOT DONE records; UNITS = foreign, alias or blank units; CATEGORY = same test code under another specimen

fields.name: RULE_IDS
fields.description: Space-separated criteria.csv RULE_IDs the record exercises in both versions: the rules that give a grade of 1 or more, the lowest applicable rule whose bound the value does not cross (grade 0), or the rules that are unevaluable (grade missing)

fields.name: LBTESTCD
fields.description: CDISC laboratory test code (analytes.csv; CD4 is sponsor-defined)

fields.name: LBTEST
fields.description: CDISC test name

fields.name: LBSPEC
fields.description: Specimen type (CDISC SPECTYPE submission value)

fields.name: LBDUR
fields.description: Collection duration (ISO 8601): PT24H marks a 24-hour collection

fields.name: VAL
fields.description: Result as an adopter's pipeline receives it, in UNIT (blank = missing result)

fields.name: UNIT
fields.description: Unit of VAL, LLN and ULN as received (foreign spellings and blanks in the UNITS module)

fields.name: LLN
fields.description: Lower limit of normal as received, in UNIT

fields.name: ULN
fields.description: Upper limit of normal as received, in UNIT

fields.name: VAL_SI
fields.description: VAL converted to UNIT_SI with the units.csv factor (blank when VAL is missing or UNIT is not convertible); a converted value is rounded to 6 decimals, so a boundary record is exact only in its as-received UNIT

fields.name: UNIT_SI
fields.description: Analyte SI unit (analytes.csv UNIT_SI)

fields.name: LLN_SI
fields.description: LLN in UNIT_SI

fields.name: ULN_SI
fields.description: ULN in UNIT_SI

fields.name: VAL_CONV
fields.description: VAL converted to UNIT_CONV (rounded to 6 decimals; informational: CTCAE prints its conventional and SI thresholds as rounded pairs, so grade a converted view only with the thresholds of the unit it is in)

fields.name: UNIT_CONV
fields.description: Analyte conventional unit (analytes.csv UNIT_CONV)

fields.name: LLN_CONV
fields.description: LLN in UNIT_CONV

fields.name: ULN_CONV
fields.description: ULN in UNIT_CONV

fields.name: DATE
fields.description: Collection date (ISO 8601)

fields.name: STUDY_DAY
fields.description: Study day relative to REF_DATE: day 1 on REF_DATE, no day 0 (ADaM ADY convention)

fields.name: REF_DATE
fields.description: Reference date (first dose); records dated on or before it are pre-treatment

fields.name: BASELINE_FLAG
fields.description: Y on the baseline record of the subject's test and specimen (last pre-treatment record with a result, see convention BASELINE_SELECTION)

fields.name: BASE_VAL
fields.description: Baseline value as received, in BASE_UNIT (blank when the subject has no baseline or the record is NOT DONE)

fields.name: BASE_UNIT
fields.description: Unit of the baseline record as received

fields.name: BASE_LLN
fields.description: Baseline record's LLN as received, in BASE_UNIT

fields.name: BASE_ULN
fields.description: Baseline record's ULN as received, in BASE_UNIT

fields.name: BASE_VAL_SI
fields.description: Baseline value in UNIT_SI

fields.name: BASE_LLN_SI
fields.description: Baseline record's LLN in UNIT_SI

fields.name: BASE_ULN_SI
fields.description: Baseline record's ULN in UNIT_SI

fields.name: BASE_VAL_CONV
fields.description: Baseline value in UNIT_CONV

fields.name: BASE_LLN_CONV
fields.description: Baseline record's LLN in UNIT_CONV

fields.name: BASE_ULN_CONV
fields.description: Baseline record's ULN in UNIT_CONV

fields.name: STATUS
fields.description: NOT DONE marker (CDISC LBSTAT); blank otherwise

fields.name: GRADABLE
fields.description: Y = a grade is expected in at least one direction and version; N = no grade is expected at all (missing result or needed limit, unknown or blank unit on an absolute-threshold test, no criterion for the test and specimen, NOT DONE)

fields.name: EXP_GRADE_LOW_V5
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v5 grade on the LOW scale under the DEFAULT profile; 0 = normal; blank = not gradable or no LOW term

fields.name: EXP_GRADE_HIGH_V5
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v5 grade on the HIGH scale under the DEFAULT profile; blank = not gradable or no HIGH term

fields.name: EXP_TERM_LOW_V5
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v5 term of the LOW scale whenever the scale applies to the test (also at grade 0 and for a missing result); blank when no term applies or the record is NOT DONE

fields.name: EXP_TERM_HIGH_V5
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v5 term of the HIGH scale whenever the scale applies

fields.name: EXP_BASE_GRADE_LOW_V5
fields.description: Expected v5 LOW grade of the subject's baseline record (blank without baseline or on NOT DONE records)

fields.name: EXP_BASE_GRADE_HIGH_V5
fields.description: Expected v5 HIGH grade of the subject's baseline record

fields.name: EXP_GRADE_V5
fields.description: Single worst v5 grade for single-scale designs: the maximum of the non-missing LOW and HIGH grades; blank when both are missing

fields.name: EXP_TERM_V5
fields.description: Term of the direction that gives EXP_GRADE_V5; when the grade is 0 and both directions have a term, blank

fields.name: EXP_GRADE_LOW_V6
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v6 grade on the LOW scale under the DEFAULT profile; 0 = normal; blank = not gradable or no LOW term

fields.name: EXP_GRADE_HIGH_V6
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v6 grade on the HIGH scale under the DEFAULT profile; blank = not gradable or no HIGH term

fields.name: EXP_TERM_LOW_V6
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v6 term of the LOW scale whenever the scale applies to the test (also at grade 0 and for a missing result); blank when no term applies or the record is NOT DONE

fields.name: EXP_TERM_HIGH_V6
fields.description: Expected CTCAE v6 term of the HIGH scale whenever the scale applies

fields.name: EXP_BASE_GRADE_LOW_V6
fields.description: Expected v6 LOW grade of the subject's baseline record (blank without baseline or on NOT DONE records)

fields.name: EXP_BASE_GRADE_HIGH_V6
fields.description: Expected v6 HIGH grade of the subject's baseline record

fields.name: EXP_GRADE_V6
fields.description: Single worst v6 grade for single-scale designs: the maximum of the non-missing LOW and HIGH grades; blank when both are missing

fields.name: EXP_TERM_V6
fields.description: Term of the direction that gives EXP_GRADE_V6; when the grade is 0 and both directions have a term, blank

fields.name: VERSION_DELTA
fields.description: Y when any v5 expectation differs from the v6 expectation of the record

fields.name: CONVENTIONS
fields.description: Space-separated conventions.csv codes whose reading the record's expectations rely on

fields.name: CONVENTION_DEP
fields.description: Y when a documented alternative reading of one of the record's conventions would change an expectation (conventions.csv CONVENTION_DEP = Y); exclude these records to validate against undisputed criteria only

fields.name: DESCRIPTION
fields.description: What the record proves, in plain words
